_comment: Asymmetric zero-pi: the zero_pi.json circuit with distinct elements (see full_zero_pi() in generate_specs.py).

J1a (theta + phi): EJ = E_J (1 + dE_J/2), C = C_J (1 - dC_J/2); J1b (-theta + phi): EJ = E_J (1 - dE_J/2), C = C_J (1 + dC_J/2); C1a = C (1 + dC/2), C1b = C (1 - dC/2); L1a energy E_L (1 - dE_L/2), L1b energy E_L (1 + dE_L/2); C_J = ghz_to_farad(E_CJ), C = ghz_to_farad(E_CS*E_CJ/(E_CJ - E_CS)).

Z_full as zero_pi.json (zeta is scqubits' FullZeroPi coordinate). Ring flux on the junctions: custom B with +1/2 of the ring flux on each junction and capacitor entries solving G B = I (static flux: a gauge choice; the irrotational B would put it on L<q>b instead, giving flux_linear on phi and zeta).

E_C is the circuit's exact inverse capacitance: it matches scqubits' first-order FullZeroPi model at dC_J = dC = 0 and differs from it at second order in (dC_J, dC). E_Cz is not independent: E_Cz = E_CS*E_CJ/(E_CJ - E_CS).
constant 0: no 2 E_J (scqubits' potential), no -E_zeta/2 (FullZeroPi's E_zeta a^dag a), no offset-charge correction.
